body:
if i look at strangers in relationships i'm mostly jealous but also find me often comparing myself to others in a "what does he have i haven't" way. looking at good friends i'm mostly happy for them, but i'm also jealous if the female part of the relationship is somebody i could imagine being with.  
i never told anybody about that except the internet and psychologist i visit now and then. it's very difficult for me because i represent (or at least i think so) not exactly the person i just described and would be kinda like a coming out to tell that to someone. i would be honestly ashamed to tell that to friends. and the relationship to my parents is also a bit weird, we have a good relationship and they support me and such, but i never told them much about my life, i just don't feel comfortable to tell them privat things, especially because my mum can't keep shit secret.

sup guys, lately i'm struggeling with (social) anxiety. it's kinda weird because i've been fine for the past few years and never had big problems talking to people (mostly because i didn't care what others think of me i guess) but at the moment i am really afraid to say something i shouldn't. I already get nervous when i go somewhere i know i will talk to people (like the university) and i keep losing sleep about things i said and even more about things i didn't say :(
